defaults.permitted_development: Across Derbyshire, domestic heat pumps are usually easiest on the planning permission route when the unit stays compact, sits discreetly, and can show a clean noise and neighbour-amenity story under the English planning system. rules.boundary_rules: Boundary siting and noise are usually the first planning pressure points for heat pumps across Derbyshire, especially where the unit sits near neighbours or a quiet garden edge.
rules.roof_rules: Heat pumps across Derbyshire are usually easier where the main roof form stays visually quiet. Roof-mounted units, brackets and prominent pipework can make a domestic retrofit feel more like plant equipment and often need a closer planning check.
rules.materials_rules: Well-scaled screening and restrained finishes usually work better than oversized housings that create a second visual problem around the plant.
